page.overview:
Who is Anna Dixon?

Commodore Anna Dixon was a Starfleet flag officer in the 24th century.

Sometime in 2364, as a Starfleet Operational Support Division officer, she sent an order about starbase operations to Commander Don Dixon of Starbase 245. (, okudagram)
